title: Middle of Linked List Values

monster.name: Bifurcating Serpent
monster.title: Splitter of Linked Arteries
monster.defeatQuote: The fast and slow runners have rendezvoused at my core!

description: Given the head values of a singly linked list as an array `values`, return the values from the middle node to the end of the list. If there are two middle nodes, return the second middle node onwards.
solutionCode:
def middleNodeValues(values: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    # Simulate slow and fast pointer: fast moves 2, slow moves 1
    slow = 0
    fast = 0
    while fast < len(values) and fast + 1 < len(values):
        slow += 1
        fast += 2
    return values[slow:]
hints: Use two pointers: fast moves two steps while slow moves one step.
